faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OIDC CFO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the OIDC Chief Financial Officer (CFO) recruitment is 20th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Chief Financial Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,06,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the CFO position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Commerce, or be a Chartered Accountant (CA) or ICWA, or hold an M.B.A in Finance from a recognized university. A minimum of five years of relevant experience is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the OIDC CFO recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the OIDC CFO job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: Omnibus Industrial Development Corporation (OIDC) has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Chief Financial Officer (CFO).

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contract-based position. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the OIDC located?
faq.answer: The OIDC is located in Masat, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, with the pincode 396230.
